papers.title: Improving stress shielding following total hip arthroplasty by using a femoral stem made of β type Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn with a Young's modulus gradation.
papers.abstract: Stress shielding-related bone loss occurs after total hip arthroplasty because the stiffness of metallic implants differs from that of the host femur. Although reducing stem stiffness can ameliorate the bone resorption, it increases stress at the bone-implant interface and can inhibit fixation. To overcome this complication, a novel cementless stem with a gradient in Young's modulus was developed using Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn (TNS) alloy. Local heat treatment applied at the neck region for increasing its strength resulted in a gradual decrease in Young's modulus from the proximal to the distal end, from 82.1 to 51.0GPa as calculated by a heat transfer simulation. The Young's modulus gradient did not induce the excessive interface stress which may cause the surface debonding. The main purpose of this study was to evaluate bone remodeling with the TNS stem using a strain-adaptive bone remodeling simulation based on finite element analysis. Our predictions showed that, for the TNS stem, bone reduction in the calcar region (Gruen zone 7) would be 13.6% at 2years, 29.0% at 5years, and 45.8% at 10years postoperatively. At 10 years, the bone mineral density for the TNS stem would be 42.6% higher than that for the similar Ti-6Al-4V alloy stem. The stress-strength ratio would be lower for the TNS stem than for the Ti-6Al-4V stem. These results suggest that although proximal bone loss cannot be eliminated completely, the TNS stem with a Young's modulus gradient may have bone-preserving effects and sufficient stem strength, without the excessive interface stress.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对髋关节假体应力遮挡问题，使用有限元模拟评估梯度模量股骨柄的骨重塑效果，与用户的方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: No experimental validation or micromotion quantification; only simulation-based bone remodeling prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统股骨柄刚度大导致应力遮挡，本文提出梯度模量设计以减少骨吸收。
summary_zh.method: 采用Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn合金并通过局部热处理实现模量梯度，利用有限元模拟骨重塑。
summary_zh.result: 梯度模量柄在Gruen 7区10年骨密度比Ti-6Al-4V柄高42.6%，且应力强度比更低。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元应变自适应骨重塑模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding-induced bone resorption after total hip arthroplasty by designing a femoral stem with a gradient in Young's modulus.
summary_en.method: A cementless stem made of Ti-33.6Nb-4Sn alloy with a graduated Young's modulus from proximal (82.1 GPa) to distal (51.0 GPa) was developed using local heat treatment and evaluated via finite element bone remodeling simulation.
summary_en.result: The predicted bone mineral density loss in Gruen zone 7 was 45.8% at 10 years for the gradient stem, which was 42.6% higher than that for a conventional Ti-6Al-4V stem, with lower stress-strength ratio.
summary_en.validation: Strain-adaptive bone remodeling simulation without experimental or clinical validation.

papers.title: Texture And Twinning In Selective Laser Melting Ti-6Al-4V Alloys
papers.abstract: Martensitic texture-phase transition in Selective Laser Melting (SLM) Ti-6Al-4V (ELI) alloys was found. Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) analysis showed the initial cubic beta < 100 > (001) BCC texture. Such kind of texture is observed in BCC metals with flat rolling texture when axis is in the direction of rolling and the texture plane coincides with the plane of rolling. It was found that the texture of the parent BCC beta-phase determined the texture of low-temperature HCP alpha-phase limited the choice of its orientation variants. The {10-12} < -1011 > twinning system in titanium alloys after SLM was determined. Analysis of the oxygen contamination in SLM alloys was done. Comparison of the obtained results with the conventional titanium alloys is also provided.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V的织构和孪晶，未涉及多孔结构设计、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学植入物相关主题。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing, no porous structure design, no implant-related biomechanics or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V合金的织构和孪晶形成机制
summary_zh.method: 采用EBSD分析SLM成型Ti-6Al-4V的β相和α相织构
summary_zh.result: 发现β相织构决定α相变体选择，并确定{10-12}孪晶系统
summary_zh.validation: 与常规钛合金结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the texture evolution and twinning mechanisms in selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloys.
summary_en.method: Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) analysis was used to characterize the crystallographic texture of both the parent beta phase and transformed alpha phase.
summary_en.result: The beta-phase texture was found to constrain the variant selection of alpha-phase, and a {10-12} twinning system was identified.
summary_en.validation: Comparison with conventionally processed titanium alloys provided qualitative validation of the texture observations.

papers.venue: World Academy of Science, Engineering and Technology, International Journal of Chemical, Molecular, Nuclear, Materials and Metallurgical Engineering

summary_zh.result: 揭示不同工艺条件下织构和孪晶的演变

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the crystallographic texture and twinning behavior in selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloys.
summary_en.method: SLM fabrication combined with electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) characterization.
summary_en.result: The study reveals the evolution of texture and twinning under different processing conditions.

papers.title: Effect of post treatments on the properties of AlSi10Mg samples produced via selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10镁铝合金的后处理，未涉及生物医用植入物、应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no osseointegration, and AlSi10Mg is not a typical biomedical implant material.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究后处理对选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg合金性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过不同的热处理和表面处理工艺对样品进行处理。
summary_zh.result: 后处理显著改善了材料的力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度等力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-treatments on the mechanical properties of AlSi10Mg samples fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Post-treatments including heat treatment and surface finishing were applied to as-built samples.
summary_en.result: Post-treatments significantly enhanced the mechanical properties such as strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile testing, hardness measurement, and microstructural analysis.
